summary: Iteration 5: full backend + frontend verification of the push-diagnostics work (Firebase Web API key probe, push-status reporting, partners-without-device), the Admin 'Alert Sound & Ring' card in Integration Center, admin->partner alert_config propagation, audio upload, and the removal of the partner Alert Settings card. Backend: 20/20 pytest cases pass (new file /app/backend/tests/test_push_diag_alertsound.py). Frontend: Admin Diagnostics tab and partner push UI all verified correct. ONE HIGH-severity UI bug found: the PremiumSelect dropdown rendered inside a Radix Dialog (e.g. the ringtone select in the Alert Sound modal) is visible but NOT clickable - clicks fall through to the element underneath (volume slider), so an admin cannot change the ringtone at all.

minor.issue: Requires auth (401 for anonymous). Review request listed it as a public regression check; not a defect, just documenting the actual contract.
Empty token returns HTTP 200 with {ok:false,error:'no_token'} instead of 400 - status code should reflect the validation error.

ui_bugs.component: PremiumSelect inside Dialog (AlertSoundModal ringtone select, /app/frontend/src/components/ui/PremiumSelect.jsx + ui/dialog.jsx)
ui_bugs.issue: Tone dropdown opens and renders options, but options are un-clickable. Radix DialogContent sets `pointer-events:none` on <body> while open; the PremiumSelect menu is portalled to document.body so it inherits pointer-events:none (verified: getComputedStyle(menu).pointerEvents === 'none', document.elementFromPoint(option center) returns the alert-volume range input). Result: (a) admin CANNOT change the ringtone from the UI (tone stays 'Classic Ring'), (b) a click intended for an option lands on the volume slider underneath and silently changes volume (observed 70% -> 45%, which then got saved). Playwright normal click times out with 'element intercepts pointer events'. Fix: add style/class pointer-events:auto on the menu container (and the mobile backdrop) in PremiumSelect, or portal the menu into the DialogContent node. This affects EVERY PremiumSelect used inside a Dialog across the admin app, not just Alert Sound.

Duplicate data-testid: the container div uses data-testid="diag-apikey-blocked" and each blocked check <li> uses data-testid={`diag-apikey-${ok?'ok':'blocked'}`}, so the selector resolves to 2 elements (Playwright strict-mode violation). Rename the row testid e.g. diag-apikey-check-<api-slug>.

integration_issues.flow: Admin Alert Sound modal -> save -> card subtitle
integration_issues.issue: Save works (toast 'Alert sound settings saved…', modal closes, PUT /api/admin/settings persists) but the card subtitle can never change to a different tone because the tone cannot be selected (see PremiumSelect pointer-events bug). Subtitle correctly reflects the persisted tone ('Tone · Classic Ring').

critical_code_review_comments: PremiumSelect renders its menu via createPortal(document.body) with no pointer-events reset - incompatible with Radix Dialog/Sheet which set body{pointer-events:none}. dialog.jsx already special-cases [data-premium-select-menu] for dismissal, so the same hook should be used to restore pointer events.

fcm_service.check_web_api_key runs two blocking urllib probes with a 10s timeout each on every GET /api/admin/notifications/health call; consider caching the result (e.g. 60s TTL) so the Diagnostics tab / repeated admin polls don't add ~1-3s latency per request.

notification_health() builds the per-role device breakdown by loading every user id per role into memory ({'user_id': {'$in': ids}}); this will not scale - use an aggregation with $lookup or store role on fcm_devices.

rca_of_the_issue: PremiumSelect ringtone dropdown un-clickable: Radix UI Dialog applies `pointer-events: none` to document.body while open and re-enables it only on DialogContent. PremiumSelect renders its option menu with createPortal into document.body (z-9999), so the menu inherits pointer-events:none. Reproduction: Admin -> System/Integration Center -> Alert Sound & Ring -> Configure -> click [data-testid=alert-tone] -> menu appears -> click [data-testid=alert-tone-opt-chime]: Playwright normal click times out ('subtree intercepts pointer events'), forced click lands on [data-testid=alert-volume] underneath and changes the volume instead; the tone label stays 'Classic Ring'. Measured in-page: getComputedStyle(document.body).pointerEvents==='none', getComputedStyle('[data-premium-select-menu]').pointerEvents==='none', document.elementFromPoint(optionCenter) === input[data-testid=alert-volume]. Mitigation: set pointerEvents:'auto' on the PremiumSelect menu wrapper (and mobile backdrop) or portal the menu into the closest DialogContent.
